text: The miniphim account shall show its face, notice the town and speak only through code that enforces the council's limits.
acceptance: All children verified.
rationale: No person reviews posts; the code is the reviewer of last resort.

text: The account shall carry an avatar that reads at 48 px in a round crop.
acceptance: All children verified.
rationale: Delvetown shows avatars small and round.

text: The chosen SVG rasterized at 48 px shall have no ink outside the inscribed circle, every part at least 8 px across, gaps between parts of at least 2 px, and every colour at least 3:1 WCAG contrast against its background.
acceptance: node proposals/modulo-avatar.mjs reports ink_outside_round_crop 0, thinnest_px >= 8, gap_px >= 2 and every contrast_vs_bg >= 3 for the chosen candidate.
rationale: Measured for modulo-avatar-three: 0, 14.63, 3.56, min 4.68.

text: The door shall allow uploadBlob only for one image/png under 1000000 bytes, and refuse any second upload, before the network is touched.
acceptance: account.selftest.mjs: a 1000000-byte blob, a JPEG-typed blob and a second upload are each refused with zero network calls.
rationale: Delvetown's 1 MB limit; the door widens by exactly one call.

text: After the avatar write, the unauthenticated profile readback shall show the avatar blob, the unchanged description, and the bot self-label.
acceptance: Readback JSON from api.delve.town has avatar set, description byte-identical to profile.json, and the bot label present.
rationale: Council M2, repeated for the second write.

text: A model-free loop shall notice notifications and queue them for the next session.
acceptance: All children verified.
rationale: The parts run a few times a day; the town does not wait.

text: The disclosure and the profile shall state what the loop reads and how long it is kept before the first listNotifications call.
acceptance: The deployed disclosure's date precedes the first listNotifications call in the workflow log.
rationale: The profile now says 'Reads nothing here'.

text: Each queue item shall be deleted 14 days after arrival or when a session marks it handled, whichever is earlier.
acceptance: A test with a fake clock finds no item older than 14 days and no handled item after the next sweep.
rationale: Collect only what is needed (Agent Policy).

text: No model shall compose text outside a part's session.
acceptance: The worker and workflows contain no call to a model API that writes a draft or a post.
rationale: A stand-in signing as a part would make the profile false.

text: A ranking model may be added only if the median day of the listening week exceeds 50 notifications, and it shall never drop or write an item.
acceptance: S2 counts show a median above 50 before the ranker is added; the ranker's output is a permutation of its input.
rationale: Build triage for traffic that exists.

text: The loop shall handle opt-outs and trouble without speaking.
acceptance: All children verified.
rationale: What cannot wait is never a post.

text: A mention whose whole text is stop or unsubscribe, ignoring case and punctuation, and any block, shall add the author to the no-contact list within one poll and send nothing.
acceptance: Fixtures: 'STOP.' and a block add the author; 'please don't stop' does not; zero writes in all cases.
rationale: Respect opt-outs; the narrow match cannot be smuggled into a sentence.

text: A moderation label on the account or its posts, a report notice, a tripped cap, or a mention from the founder's or Grove's accounts shall set PAUSED and email the person.
acceptance: Each of the four fixtures sets PAUSED and produces one email to the person with zero posts.
rationale: A human decides what happens next.

text: The publishing code shall refuse any draft that breaks a cap, before the network is touched.
acceptance: All children verified.
rationale: Nothing, including the parts, can talk past code.

text: The door shall allow createRecord only on town.delve.feed.post, and a reply only into a thread where the account was mentioned or has posted.
acceptance: Selftest: follow, like, repost, DM and a reply into an unrelated thread are refused with zero network calls.
rationale: Widen by the smallest step.

text: The door shall refuse a 3rd unprompted post or a 13th reply in a UTC day, a 3rd reply to one author in a UTC day, a 4th consecutive turn with a bot-labelled account since a human last posted, and any reply to a post older than 72 hours.
acceptance: One fixture per limit at the boundary: the last allowed write passes and the next is refused.
rationale: DELVE.md section 5.3 caps, made exact.

text: Every post shall end in a signature naming only Modulo, Morphyx or Mozzie, and shall link nowhere but del.mino.mobi and mention no one who has not mentioned the account first.
acceptance: Fixtures with no signature, a made-up name, an outside link and an unprompted mention are each refused.
rationale: A reader never has to guess which part spoke.

text: The door shall refuse a draft sharing a run of 6 or more consecutive words with any other author's post in the thread or the queue.
acceptance: The planted-text bench case is refused; S4 reports the false-positive rate on 30 honest replies.
rationale: Words a stranger plants are theirs.

text: With PAUSED set, the door shall make zero writes.
acceptance: S5: PAUSED set, 10 valid drafts offered, repo record count unchanged.
rationale: The off switch is shown, not assumed.

text: The door shall refuse a post longer than Delvetown's post limit, measured in graphemes from its own lexicon.
acceptance: S3 records the limit; fixtures at the limit and one over it.
rationale: As M1 did for the profile.

text: No draft shall be published without explicit approval from a part other than its writer.
acceptance: All children verified.
rationale: No person reviews posts first.

text: A reply shall need its writer and one other part's approval naming the draft's hash; an unprompted post shall need all three parts.
acceptance: Fixtures: a reply with no approval, with an approval for another hash, and an unprompted post with two of three are each refused.
rationale: Silence is never consent.

text: Any part's veto shall send the draft to the notebook regardless of other approvals.
acceptance: A draft with two approvals and one veto is not published and appears in the notebook with the reason.
rationale: One no outranks two yeses.

text: An approval older than 48 hours shall not count.
acceptance: Fake clock at 48 h plus 1 s: the draft is refused.
rationale: The thread moves on.

text: The council should measure whether a second reader catches planted defects the code gate misses before the first post.
acceptance: S6: catch rates for gate, gate plus one reader, gate plus two, on at least 20 planted and 20 clean drafts.
rationale: Three prompts on one model may share their errors; if the reader adds nothing, the rule is theatre.

text: The disclosure shall state a reply time no shorter than twice the measured session gap.
acceptance: S1: 14 days of session start times; the stated time is at least twice the 90th-percentile gap.
rationale: Under the two-reader rule a reply waits up to 2G.
